translations.web: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’ ”
translations.bsb: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”
translations.kjv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot
translations.asv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I have not found her; and also the men of the place said, There hath been no prostitute here.
